name: Shin◯ no Kyojin Doujin Novel Game
original_name: 進◯の巨人同人ノベルゲーム
source:
A doujin NVL game based on [URL=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attack_on_Titan]Shingeki no Kyojin[/URL], set in an alternate timeline just before the conclusion of the Female Titan arc. It features an original female character- Michiru Clemens (renameable)- as the protagonist. The romanceable canon characters are Levi, Nanaba (treated as male) and Erwin, with Hange (treated as male) and Nile being side characters. 

It also contains non-sexually explicit [R15+] "bonus" romantic stories with Mikasa being interested in Eren, and Bertolt having feelings for Annie but Annie already being interested in Armin.
translation:
一部以[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Attack_on_Titan]《进击的巨人》[/url]为基础的同人NVL游戏，故事发生在女巨人篇结束前不久的平行时间线。原创女角色米琪露·克莱门斯（可改名）担任主人公。可攻略的原作角色包括利威尔、纳拿巴（设定为男性）和埃尔文；韩吉（设定为男性）与奈尔则是配角。

此外还包含非色情、R15+级的“额外”恋爱故事：三笠喜欢艾伦，贝尔托特喜欢安妮，但安妮已经对阿尔敏产生好感。
